fee_notes: Royalty structure is tiered and varies by agreement type. Kiosk (new franchisee / Existing Franchisee Expansion Program): Year 1 = 3%, Year 2 = 6%, Year 3 = 9%, Year 4+ = 15% of Gross Volume of Business. Storefront (Existing Franchisee Expansion Program): Year 1 = 5%, Year 2 = 10%, Year 3+ = 15%. NFA Renewal Addendum: 15% (or lower if original agreement provided lower rate). Non-compliance triggers a 1 percentage point royalty increase. Advertising fee is 6.5% of Gross Volume of Business, but automatically increases to 7% if New Customer Growth Rate exceeds 2% for two consecutive Reporting Years (and reverts to 6.5% if growth falls below 2% average over two consecutive Reporting Years). Technology Fee varies and may be charged on a per-tax-return or other basis; no fixed monthly amount disclosed. Technical Assistance Fee varies and is only charged if a Processing Center generates a substantial number of support cases. Transfer Fee: $10,000/Territory for 1-5 Territories; $7,500/Territory for 6-15 Territories; $5,000/Territory for 16+ Territories (capped at 0.125x purchase price, minimum $2,500/transferor). Processing Fee (Competing Business acquisition): $1,000 for 400-1,000 returns; $2,000 for 1,001-2,500 returns; $2,500 for 2,500+ returns. Cooperative Program Participation Fee: 50% of Qualifying Marketing Expenditures (optional participation). Late Gross Volume Report Fee: $50/day. Late payment interest: lesser of 18%/year or highest legal rate. Insufficient Funds Charge: $100. Liquidated Damages apply on early termination. All fees nonrefundable.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee (Franchise Agreement, Existing Franchisee Expansion Program – Kiosks): First Reporting Year—3% of Gross Volume of Business; Second Reporting Year—6% of Gross Volume of Business; Third Reporting Year—9% of Gross Volume of Business; Fourth and subsequent Reporting Years—15% of Gross Volume of Business
Royalty Fee (Existing Franchisee Expansion Program – Storefront): First Reporting Year—5% of Gross Volume of Business; Second Reporting Year—10% of Gross Volume of Business; Third and subsequent Reporting Years—15% of Gross Volume of Business
Royalty Fee (NFA Renewal Addendum): 15% of Gross Volume of Business (or lower if your original franchise agreement provided for a lower royalty rate)
Advertising Fee: 6.5% of Gross Volume of Business
Technical Assistance Fee: Varies
Amendment Fee: The greater of our costs associated with the amendment or $250
Direct Deposit User or License Fee: Actual cost
Technology Fee: Varies
Cooperative Program Participation Fee: 50% of the amount you elect to spend on Qualifying Marketing Expenditures under the Cooperative Program
Service and Product Testing Fee: Varies
Payments to Customers: Equal to the tax preparations fee and/or any other amounts we pay to your customers
Transfer Fee: $10,000 per Territory for 1 to 5 Territories; $7,500 per Territory for 6 to 15 Territories; $5,000 per Territory for 16 or more Territories
Processing Fee: 400 to 1,000 tax returns = $1,000; 1,001 to 2,500 tax returns = $2,000; More than 2,500 tax returns = $2,500
Late Gross Volume Report Fee: $50 per day
Interest on Late Payments: Lesser of 18% per year or the highest legal rate allowed in your state
Insufficient Funds Charge: $100
Non-Compliance Fee: Increase in Royalty rate by 1 percentage point
Audit Expenses: Costs we incur for our employees' travel, room, board and other related expenses
Enforcement Costs: Varies
Indemnity: Varies
Liquidated Damages: Varies
Failure to Cooperate with Audit Fee: $5,000 for first failure; $10,000 for second or subsequent failure
Failure to Submit Business Improvement Plan Fee: $2,500 for first failure; $5,000 for second failure
Unauthorized Advertising or Marketing Fee: $10,000 per instance
Fee for Violating a Manual Provision: $10,000 per instance
